channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Record-breaking climber Nirmal Purja among those killed in avalanche
item.description: 14 Peaks star Nirmal Purja has died in an avalanche while leading 10 climbers up Broad Peak mountain in Pakistan.

item.title: At least three killed in explosion near cafe in Russia’s Moscow
item.description: More than 15 people also ​injured ‌in the blast in Kudrinskaya Square, authorities say.

item.title: At least 9 people killed in Russian missile attacks on Kyiv
item.description: At least 9 people have been killed and dozens injured in Russian missile strikes on Kyiv.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill seven across Gaza, destroy medical supply warehouse
item.description: Attacks kill seven as Gaza Health Ministry condemns 'heinous' strike on medicine stores, days after disarmament deal.

item.title: Israeli strike destroys Gaza hospital warehouse
item.description: Israeli strike destroys medical supplies warehouse at Gaza's Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, staff say.

item.title: Iran warns against ‘flames of war’ amid US strike threats on energy sites
item.description: Iranian media says retaliation plan ready after US media suggest potential imminent attacks against civilian sites.

item.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
item.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

item.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
item.description: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

item.title: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
item.description: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

item.title: Three killed after woman detonates bomb at Moscow restaurant, state media say
item.description: Security officials said the female attacker tried to enter the restaurant but was stopped by a security guard.
